training.exploit: Upload XML beginning with `<!DOCTYPE r [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]>` and reference `&x;` in an element — the parser inlines the file's contents, which the app then stores or echoes. Swap in `SYSTEM "http://169.254.169.254/..."` for SSRF, or use parameter entities to exfiltrate file contents out-of-band.

hints.line: The flaw is what the parser is allowed to do, set where it's created.
hints.bugClass: External references in XML get resolved.
hints.why: What do default settings let a `SYSTEM` entity reach?
hints.fix: Turn off DTDs and external entities on the factory.

writeup.summary: A default `DocumentBuilderFactory` resolves DTDs and external entities, so an uploaded document declaring `<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "file:///...">` makes the parser read local files (disclosure) or fetch URLs (SSRF) as it parses. The fix hardens the factory before parsing: disallow DOCTYPE declarations and disable external general/parameter entities (and XInclude). Schema validation and size limits don't help because the external fetch happens during parsing itself.
